meta.title: حروب الوردتين
meta.note: All cue times are seconds on the narration timeline, taken from word timestamps in transcript.json.

scenes.topic: Hook: medieval England saw no ice creatures and no dragons
scenes.visual: Line-drawn ice crystal and dragon wing materialise in darkness, then are struck out and crumble into ash
scenes.animation: stroke-draw symbols, word reveals, crimson strike, particle disintegration

scenes.topic: A bloody struggle for power between two noble families over generations
scenes.visual: Split composition: Lancaster crimson (right) vs York ivory (left) divided by a blade of light; lineage threads multiply; allegiance nodes flicker between colours
scenes.animation: split wipe, rose bloom, lineage strands growing, nodes switching colour

scenes.topic: The Wars of the Roses inspired much of the drama in Game of Thrones
scenes.visual: Main title: crown above two roses; title in large Naskh; Latin subtitle; ornaments
scenes.animation: hairlines extend, title mask reveal, crown stroke-draw, roses bloom

scenes.topic: Roots of the war: death of Edward III in 1377
scenes.visual: Chapter card, then a large crown over Edward III's name with 1377 rolling into place
scenes.animation: chapter card, crown draw, digit roll

scenes.topic: Eldest son died first; grandson Richard II (10) inherited over three living sons; Lancaster from 3rd son, York from 4th son
scenes.visual: Animated family tree of Edward III's sons; Richard II takes the crown; branches of John of Gaunt (crimson) and Edmund of Langley (ivory) light up
scenes.animation: nodes pop in, elbow connectors draw, crown moves to the grandson, branch colour floods

scenes.topic: The war's name comes from the two family emblems: white rose of York, red rose of Lancaster
scenes.visual: Two heraldic roses bloom on either side of a vertical rule
scenes.animation: petal bloom, labels mask in

scenes.topic: Lancaster seizes the throne first: Henry IV deposes his cousin Richard II in 1399
scenes.visual: Crown passes from an ivory Richard II node to a crimson Henry IV node; timeline begins 1377 → 1399
scenes.animation: crown arc transfer, timeline extension, marker pop

scenes.topic: Lancastrian rule stable until 1422, when Henry V died on campaign leaving infant Henry VI as king
scenes.visual: Timeline continues to 1422; broken sword for Henry V; an oversized crown above a tiny infant node

text.ev: وفاة هنري الخامس في حملة عسكرية

scenes.animation: timeline pan, sword fracture, scale contrast

scenes.topic: Henry VI weak and dominated by advisers; married to Margaret of Anjou for French support
scenes.visual: Henry node with puppet-string lines from adviser nodes above; Margaret joins via a marriage line from France (fleur-de-lis)
scenes.animation: string tension, rings draw

scenes.topic: Margaret: beautiful, ambitious, ruthless towards anyone threatening her power, above all Richard Duke of York
scenes.visual: Kinetic triptych of adjectives; a crimson queen's crown; an ivory node for Richard of York appears under tension
scenes.animation: word stagger, tension line vibrates

scenes.topic: Richard was a trusted adviser and loyal commander, but the queen pushed him out in favour of Suffolk and Somerset
scenes.visual: Concentric court rings around the king; York's node moves from inner ring to outer; Suffolk and Somerset take the inner seats
scenes.animation: orbital motion, node displacement

scenes.topic: York criticised the conduct of the French war, was removed from court and sent to Ireland; amid corruption and defeats he returned with an army
scenes.visual: Map of the British Isles and northern France: France pulses (losses), York's marker travels London → Dublin, unrest pulses over England, return route Dublin → Wales → London
scenes.animation: map reveal, camera glide, animated dashed routes

scenes.topic: Failed at first; after the king's mental collapse York became Protector; within a year Henry recovered and York was dismissed, his reforms undone
scenes.visual: Henry's crown fractures; an ivory shield rises with 'Protector of the Realm 1454'; then the crown re-forms, the shield dims and the list of reforms is struck through
scenes.animation: crown shatter into shards, shield draw, shards reassemble, strike-throughs

scenes.topic: York raised a new army (first battle, St Albans 1455); could not take the crown but was made heir (Act of Accord, 1460)
scenes.visual: Chapter card; map marker at St Albans with the first armed clash; then a throne crown out of reach and a red royal seal stamping 'heir'
scenes.animation: battle marker pulse, crown hover, seal stamp

scenes.topic: York's tragic end: killed in battle against the queen's supporters; his head set on a spike
scenes.visual: Abstract battle diagram at Wakefield (Dec 1460): crimson formations close on a smaller ivory block, which breaks; then a lone vertical spike with a paper crown at Micklegate Bar, York
scenes.animation: formations converge, ivory block scatters, slow vertical rise

scenes.topic: His young son inherited the claim and was crowned Edward IV
scenes.visual: Sun in splendour (Edward's badge) radiates; ivory crown descends onto the name Edward IV; 1461
scenes.animation: rays unfold, crown descent, digit roll

scenes.topic: Edward won great victories over Lancaster; Henry VI captured; Margaret fled abroad with her son Edward
scenes.visual: Map of England: Towton 1461 battle marker; Henry VI marker moves to London (Tower, 1465); Margaret and prince route out across the sea into exile
scenes.animation: map pan north → south, routes

scenes.topic: Edward's fatal mistake: he abandoned a planned French royal match and secretly married the widow of a minor noble
scenes.visual: Chapter card; Edward node with a dashed line to a French princess (fleur-de-lis) that is cut; a solid ring-line to Elizabeth Woodville, 1464
scenes.animation: line cut with spark, rings draw

scenes.topic: The marriage angered Edward's strongest ally Warwick, who turned against him, joined Lancaster and won over Edward's jealous brother George
scenes.visual: Split field York (left) / Lancaster (right); Warwick's link to Edward snaps; Warwick crosses to the crimson side, George follows
scenes.animation: link snap, node migration across the divide, colour change

scenes.topic: Warwick briefly restored Henry VI (1470); Edward quickly regained power; Prince Edward killed in battle; Henry died in captivity
scenes.visual: Crown flips to crimson '1470'; map: Barnet (Apr 1471) and Tewkesbury (May 1471) markers; Henry VI's node fades in the Tower
scenes.animation: crown colour flip, map markers, node fade

scenes.topic: Edward IV's reign continued in relative peace; after his death in 1483 blood flowed again
scenes.visual: Chapter card; a long, quiet timeline 1471 → 1483; at 1483 crimson ink bleeds across the line
scenes.animation: slow line, ink bleed blooms

scenes.topic: Edward's 12-year-old son was the rightful heir; his uncle Richard III declared him illegitimate because of the secret marriage, took the throne and confined the boys in the Tower
scenes.visual: Edward V node with crown; Richard III node; a crimson 'illegitimate' seal stamps over Edward V; crown slides to Richard; two small nodes enclosed by a tower outline
scenes.animation: stamp impact, crown slide, tower draw

scenes.topic: The princes vanished; their fate is unknown to this day; Richard's power seemed stable for a while
scenes.visual: Large tower silhouette at night; two lit windows go dark; text 'fate unknown'; a steady crown with a faint tremor
scenes.animation: window lights fade, slow push-in

scenes.topic: Two years later, danger came from across the English Channel
scenes.visual: Chapter card; wide map of the Channel; a crimson glow rises over Brittany/France
scenes.animation: map glide, glow pulse

scenes.topic: Henry Tudor, of Lancastrian descent, raised in exile; exploited divisions inside York and gathered support
scenes.visual: Lineage thread from John of Gaunt down to Henry Tudor; exile label; then an ivory York rose cracks in two and ivory nodes drift to Henry's side

text.htSub: من سلالة جون أوف غونت · لانكاستر

scenes.animation: lineage dotted draw, rose split, node migration

scenes.topic: He led an army from France across the Channel in 1485
scenes.visual: Map: route Harfleur → Milford Haven (7 Aug 1485) → Bosworth
scenes.animation: camera follows route head

scenes.topic: Henry defeated Richard III's forces quickly (Bosworth Field, 22 Aug 1485)
scenes.visual: Abstract battle diagram: formations meet, Richard's ivory crown falls and turns to dust
scenes.animation: fast convergence, crown fall

scenes.topic: Henry married Elizabeth of York, sister of the vanished princes, uniting the red and white roses and ending nearly a century of war
scenes.visual: Two nodes join with rings; red and white roses glide together and merge into the Tudor rose; '1399 — 1485' compresses
scenes.animation: rings, rose merge morph, title

scenes.topic: We imagine historical wars as decisive conflicts with clear winners and losers
scenes.visual: A crisp binary: one bold block rises (winner), one sinks (loser), clean rule between them
scenes.animation: precise geometric motion

scenes.topic: But the Wars of the Roses show victory is relative, alliances shifting, and even royal power fleeting like the seasons
scenes.visual: The binary blocks tilt and dissolve; three statements appear; a crown dissolves into drifting petals
scenes.animation: dissolution into particles, word reveals

scenes.topic: End card
scenes.visual: Tudor rose, title and dates; fade to black
scenes.animation: slow fade
